video_title: Jalen Brunson & DMC Give Back to Communities

quotes.speaker: Sandra Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandra Brunson on the village that shaped Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: everyone together gave Jalen a different impact, a different voice, a different view
quotes.quote: Whether it was our parents, aunts, uncles, cousins, teachers, advisors, and coaches, everyone together gave Jalen a different impact, a different voice, a different view, and I feel he embraced that. As a mom, sometimes they don't want to hear it from me, but the people in our village, we all had the same vision, the same values, the same focus.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of giving back to others
quotes.excerpt: It's important for me to kind of give back and no matter what circumstances are
quotes.quote: It's important for me to kind of give back and no matter what circumstances are, backgrounds, or whatever, you always want to help by being in other people's corner when they may not have people in their corner.

quotes.speaker: Darryl McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryl McDaniels on how a child's situation doesn't define them
quotes.excerpt: a child's situation doesn't define who they are
quotes.quote: A child's situation doesn't define who they are. They define it, and it's also the people around them. So this family is being a family for all children, because having a family has nothing to do with just flesh and blood.

quotes.speaker: Darryl McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryl McDaniels on the mission of the Second Round Foundation
quotes.excerpt: we represent is giving an opportunity to every child to be the people they were put here
quotes.quote: They see themselves, and that's very important. What we represent is giving an opportunity to every child to be the people they were put here to be. All of the kids that we touch are the next great you and me.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on finding fulfillment through helping others
quotes.excerpt: if we help out one person, I feel fulfilled
quotes.quote: I see opportunity for them, most importantly. It may not seem like a lot, but the certain things that we do, there's more than the other things. If we help out one person, I feel fulfilled. To be able to do that, especially with my family, regardless of anything I would have done, whether I made the NBA or not, I feel like we would be giving back and doing something like that.

quotes.speaker: Sandra Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandra Brunson on the core values of the Brunson family
quotes.excerpt: That people matter, that we care
quotes.quote: That people matter, that we care.
